injuries.name: Aleksander Barkov
injuries.note: Barkov opted for non-surgical rehab after suffering a lower-body injury in Thursday's 4-3 overtime loss to San Jose. Florida placed Barkov on long-term injured reserve Saturday. He didn't earn a point in his first two appearances of the 2026-27 campaign, but he recorded two shots on net, two blocked shots and one hit.

injuries.name: Jonah Gadjovich
injuries.note: Gadjovich hasn't played since Oct. 25, 2025 because of the injury. He had three assists, seven PIM and 30 hits in 10 regular-season appearances last campaign. Gadjovich is expected to see time on the fourth line once he's available.

injuries.name: Jacob Melanson
injuries.note: The Kraken said that there would be a "gradual progression to return to hockey," so Melanson shouldn't be expected to play for a while. The 23-year-old suffered the injury in Seattle's Season Opener against Calgary on Oct. 1. Melanson had two goals and five points in 36 regular-season outings with the Kraken in 2025-26.

injuries.name: Ryan Lindgren
injuries.note: Lindgren suffered the upper-body injury in the first period of Tuesday's clash against the Golden Knights before he ultimately was removed from the game ahead of the second stanza. Prior to going down, the 28-year-old blueliner compiled a plus-three rating, seven PIM, three shots on goal and four blocked shots across four outings to begin the 2026-27 campaign. While he is sidelined over the next four to six weeks, Josh Mahura is expected to see an increased role.

injuries.name: Jake O'Brien
injuries.note: O'Brien was initially announced on injured reserve Sunday, but his status has since been clarified. He is considered week-to-week at this time. The Kraken have a few options for when he gets healthy -- as a 19-year-old first-round pick (2025), he is eligible for the AHL if Seattle thinks that would be best for his development.

injuries.name: Aleksander Barkov
injuries.note: Lower Body: The Florida Panthers placed F Aleksander Barkov on long-term injured reserve and his recovery timeline is 6-8 weeks as of Tuesday (Oct. 6).

injuries.name: Jonah Gadjovich
injuries.note: Upper-body: The Florida Panthers placed F Jonah Gadjovich on injured reserve on Tuesday (Sep. 29) and is OUT indefinitely.

injuries.name: Radko Gudas
injuries.note: Undisclosed: Gudas did not play in Thursday's (Oct. 15) game against the Canucks.

injuries.name: Brad Marchand
injuries.note: Leg: The Florida Panthers placed F Brad Marchand on injured reserve on Monday (Oct. 12).

injuries.name: Jacob Markstrom
injuries.note: Undisclosed: Markstrom did not play in Thursday's (Oct. 15) game against the Canucks.

injuries.name: Ryan Lindgren
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Seattle Kraken placed D Ryan Lindgren on injured reserve on Thursday (Oct. 8). He is expected to miss four to six weeks.

injuries.name: Jacob Melanson
injuries.note: Chest: The Seattle Kraken said on Saturday (Oct. 10) that Melanson was diagnosed with an anterior mediastinum hematoma with vascular pseudo aneurysm and is out indefinitely.

injuries.name: Brandon Montour
injuries.note: Lower Body: Montour did not finish Thursday's (Oct. 15) game versus the Lightning.

injuries.name: Jake O'Brien
injuries.note: Lower-Body: The Seattle Kraken placed F Jake O'Brien on non-roster injured reserve on Wednesday (Sept. 30).
